name: Schermbeck (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with narrow green stripes along both edges, charged in the upper part with the municipal arms of Schermbeck (a red castle above waves on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Schermbeck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
